headline: Amazon plans more powerful agentic Alexa with 'Moonraker' project
summary: Amazon is working on an updated Alexa with advanced AI capabilities, codenamed 'Moonraker'.
details: Amazon is reportedly working on an updated version of Alexa, codenamed 'Moonraker', which aims to enhance the AI assistant's ability to handle multi-step tasks more effectively. The project focuses on building out Alexa's agentic abilities, allowing it to handle complex interactions with multiple simultaneous requests.

Examples of the advanced capabilities include asking the assistant to book a ride and text a friend in a single interaction. This move is intended to enable Alexa to better compete with agentic AI models from companies like Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI.

The project is expected to incur significant costs, with projected GPU costs of more than $100 million in 2026. Internal documents suggest that Amazon is planning to use 'hundreds' of NVIDIA GPUs to power the Moonraker project, along with an Anthropic Sonnet model for testing advanced reasoning and visual responses.

The development of Moonraker comes as Amazon continues to build out Alexa+'s features, including the introduction of three new personality styles and a 'sassy' option. Despite the new leaks, Amazon appears committed to enhancing its AI assistant offerings.
